description: Delicious Pizza, Beer, Daiquiris, & Quick Bites. Great Food for the whole family. Choose from a thin crust pizza with Whole Milk Buffalo Mozzarella, Traditional and Boneless Wings, a fresh Greek Salad, or an appetizer of our must have Garlic Cheese Toast. We use the Best Mozzarella cheese available on the market for our Pizza, our Salads and Vegetables are cut fresh. Even our Greek Sauce is made in house from scratch.
